scenes.name: A FAMILIAR SQUARE
lines: For real numbers, twice x times y is at most x squared plus y squared. The difference is a square.
对实数，二倍的 x 乘 y 不超过 x 平方加 y 平方，因为差是一个平方。
Can we replace the numbers by matrices and still compare products of their eigenvalues?
把数换成矩阵后，还能比较特征值的乘积吗？
Malkoun asked this question. Haobo Ma and Wenlin Zhang give a bound that even includes absolute values.
Malkoun 提出了这个问题。Haobo Ma 与 Wenlin Zhang 给出了连绝对值也能控制的界。

scenes.name: POSITIVE INPUTS, NEGATIVE OUTPUT
lines: Start with these two real symmetric matrices. Their quadratic expressions are a squared coordinate and a squared sum, so both are positive semidefinite.
从这两个实对称矩阵开始。它们的二次式分别是坐标平方与和的平方，因此都正半定。
The mixed matrix H has determinant minus one. Its eigenvalues have opposite signs, even though both input matrices are positive semidefinite.
混合矩阵 H 的行列式为负一。尽管两个输入都正半定，H 的特征值却异号。
The comparison matrix R has determinant two. The paper bounds the absolute value: one is at most two.
比较矩阵 R 的行列式是二。论文控制绝对值：一不超过二。

scenes.name: SUM SMALL DETERMINANTS
lines: An elementary symmetric function chooses k eigenvalues, multiplies them, and adds over all choices.
初等对称函数每次选择 k 个特征值相乘，再对所有选择相加。
The first is the trace; the last is the determinant. Between them lies a whole family of quantities.
第一个是迹，最后一个是行列式，中间还有一整套量。
There is another way to compute each one: add the principal minors of size k. Choose the same rows and columns, then take a determinant.
每一项还可通过所有 k 阶主子式相加得到：选择相同下标的行和列，再取行列式。

scenes.name: THE SWAP THAT MATTERS
lines: Now let A and B be any complex rectangular matrices of the same size. Select a set of columns from each.
现在让 A 和 B 是任意同尺寸的复长方形矩阵，分别选择同一组列。
Stack A above B to make U. Swap the blocks to make V. The two Gram matrices agree: swapping preserves every column inner product.
把 A 放在 B 上方堆成 U，再交换两块得到 V。交换保留各列内积，所以两个 Gram 矩阵相同。
Their common Gram matrix is the selected part of R. The cross product gives the selected part of H.
共同的 Gram 矩阵就是 R 的相应主子矩阵，交叉相乘则得到 H 的相应主子矩阵。

scenes.name: CAUCHY–SCHWARZ ON MINOR LISTS
lines: Cauchy–Binet expands the cross determinant into an inner product of two lists of row minors.
Cauchy–Binet 把交叉行列式展开为两个行子式列表的内积。
Ordinary Cauchy–Schwarz bounds this inner product by the lengths of those lists. Those squared lengths are the two Gram determinants.
普通 Cauchy–Schwarz 用两个列表的长度控制内积，长度平方就是两个 Gram 行列式。
Here the Gram matrices agree. Their determinant is nonnegative, so taking square roots bounds each absolute principal minor of H by its counterpart in R.
这里 Gram 矩阵相同，行列式非负；取平方根后，H 的每个主子式绝对值都被 R 的对应主子式控制。

scenes.name: FROM MINORS BACK TO EIGENVALUES
lines: The absolute value of a sum is at most the sum of absolute values. Bound each minor, then add.
总和的绝对值不超过绝对值之和。逐项控制主子式，然后相加。
This proves the symmetric function bound for every k from zero to n, including singular matrices. No inverse or limit is needed.
这就证明了从零到 n 的每一阶对称函数界，包括奇异矩阵，无需逆矩阵或取极限。
Set A equal to X and B equal to Y. For Hermitian inputs, the stars disappear and we recover the stronger answer to the opening question.
令 A 等于 X、B 等于 Y。Hermitian 条件消去星号，便得到开头问题的更强答案。

scenes.name: ONE PRECISE FORMAL STATEMENT
lines: The public Lean theorem proves the original one-sided inequality for positive semidefinite Hermitian inputs, in positive dimension and for k from one to n.
公开 Lean 定理证明原来的单向不等式：正半定 Hermitian 输入，维数为正，k 从一到 n。
The absolute-value and rectangular extensions have the written proofs explained here. Their formalization is a separate next step.
绝对值与长方形推广有这里解释的书面证明，其形式化是另一个待推进的步骤。
The key idea to remember is simple: swap the stacks, preserve the Gram matrix, then sum the minor bounds.
记住这个关键动作：交换堆叠，保持 Gram 矩阵，再把主子式的界相加。
